author: KEXP
description: Dancing between traditional and contemporary sounds, Hindustani psych rock collective Karma Sheen embrace a deep sense of reflection and exploration through music. Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales, the band shares a performance of "Bageshree" and more.
title: Karma Sheen performs "Bageshree" Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Karma Sheen performing live at ESMA in Rennes, France, during Trans Musicales 2025. Recorded December 06, 2025. 

Songs:
Without You (Raag Jog) 00:00
Alaap (Jog) 06:58
Bageshree 10:15
Mian Ki Jive 13:15
Ishq Kalma 18:38
Electric Poppadom 22:55
 
Sameer Khan - Vocals, Harmonium, Guitar, Bansuri
Rodrigo Bourganos - Sitar, Theremin, Synth
Arun Dhanjal - Drums
Amad Chima - Guitar
Grisha Grebennikov - Bass

Host: Morgan
